QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Ericsson's Ingredients for Medicine 2
QuestInfo.1: According to #p2012018#, #p2111005# isn't a full fairy, rather a mix of Fairy and Human. He says that's why fairy medicine won't be as effective on her. #p2012018# wants to use medicine that is even stronger and requests that you collect #b100 #t4000061#s#k.    \n#i4000061##t4000061# #b#c4000061##k/100
QuestInfo.2: Once I got him all the ingredients, #p2012018# told me to wait as he made a new batch of medicine.

0.0: 키니는 요정이 아니야. 아니, 정확히 말하면 완전한 요정이 아니라고 할 수 있지. 그 애는 인간과의 혼혈이니까. 그렇기 때문에 요정을 위한 약이 잘 듣지 않아. 별로 좋은 선택은 아니지만... 하는 수 없지. 좀 더 강력한 약을 써봐야겠어. 이번에도 도와주겠지?

yes.0: 그럼 페어리의 더듬이 20개와 러스터픽시의 태양조각 50개를 구해다 줘. 조금 너무 강력할 것 같아서 걱정이긴 하지만... 그래도 어쩔 수 없지. 그 정도는 되어야 약이 효과가 있을 것 같으니...

no.0: 치사하게 여기까지 와서 안 할 생각이야? 너무하다고 생각 안해?

0.0: For #p2111005#, regular medicine would not work for her. That's because she's not 100% Fairy. She's half human, half Fairy. That's why the medicine for Fairies doesn't really work for her. Not quite the best of both worlds, know what I mean?
0.1: I know this may be unwise, but...there's no other way. I think I'll have to raise the potency of the medicine. You'll help me this time, too, right?

yes.0: Please get me #b100 #t4000061#s#k. This medicine will be so potent that I hesitate to use it on a young kid like #p2111005#, but... there's nothing else we can do at this point. It may be the only way we're able to save her...

no.0: You came all the way back, and now you don't want to do it? Don't you think that's just wrong?

1.0: Good, you brought everything. Now just wait for a bit, as I make a new batch for my niece...

item.0: I don't think you got all the ingredients yet. Did you forget what I asked? I need #b100 #t4000061#s#k.
